newsitem.title: USA: Conseco to redeem all Series D preferred.
newsitem.headline: Conseco to redeem all Series D preferred.

text.p: Conseco Inc said Tuesday it called for redemption all 5.3 million outstanding shares of its Series D cumulative convertible preferred stock.
The Series D stock will be redeemed on September 26 at $52.916 per share in cash, including $0.641 per share of accrued and accumulated unpaid dividends.
Each Series D share can be converted into 1.5686 shares of Conseco common until the close of business on September 20.

Conversion will result in cash flow savings and improve the company's capital position, Conseco said. The 8.3 million common shares issuable on conversion of the Series D shares already are included in Conseco's weighted average shares outstanding for purposes of computing fully diluted earnings per share.
